mapper.sql: SELECT oi2.id AS item_id, CASE WHEN t.line_sum > 0 THEN / t.line_sum ELSE 1.0 / t.cnt END AS share, CASE WHEN oi2.id = t.first_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS head FROM ecom_order_item oi2
SELECT oi3.order_id, SUM(oi3.amount + COALESCE(oi3.shipping, 0) + COALESCE(oi3.tax, 0) - COALESCE(oi3.discount, 0)) AS line_sum, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(oi3.id) AS first_id FROM ecom_order_item oi3
mapper.select: SELECT o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, COALESCE(o.ship_country, '') AS country, YEAR(o.order_time) * 100 + MONTH(o.order_time) AS period, MAX(oi.material_id) AS material_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(x.head) AS order_heads, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty, SUM(x.share * o.total_base) AS sales_gross, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.withheld_tax, 0) * o.exchange_rate) AS withheld, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.vat_amount, 0) * o.exchange_rate) AS vat, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.platform_fee, 0) * o.exchange_rate) AS commission, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.fulfillment_fee, 0) * o.exchange_rate) AS fba_fee, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.return_fee, 0) * o.exchange_rate) AS return_fee, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.other_fee, 0) * o.exchange_rate) AS other_fee, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.refund_amount, 0) * o.exchange_rate) AS refund, SUM(COALESCE(oi.cost, 0)) AS cost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' THEN x.share * COALESCE(o.shipping_cost, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS head_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' THEN 0 ELSE x.share * COALESCE(o.shipping_cost, 0) END) AS last_mile FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN ( JOIN ( JOIN ecom_order o3 ON o3.id = oi3.order_id WHERE o3.order_time >= #{begin} AND o3.order_time < #{end} AND o3.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY oi3.order_id) t ON t.order_id = oi2.order_id) x ON x.item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, COALESCE(o.ship_country, ''), YEAR(o.order_time) * 100 + MONTH(o.order_time)

SELECT o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, COALESCE(o.ship_country, '') AS country, YEAR() * 100 + MONTH() AS period, si.item_type, SUM(x.share * si.amount * st.exchange_rate) AS amount FROM ecom_settlement_item si JOIN ecom_settlement st ON st.id = si.settlement_id JOIN ecom_order o ON o.store_id = st.store_id AND o.platform_order_no = si.platform_order_no JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN ( JOIN ( GROUP BY oi3.order_id) t ON t.order_id = oi2.order_id) x ON x.item_id = oi.id WHERE >= #{begin} AND <= #{end} AND st.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, COALESCE(o.ship_country, ''), YEAR() * 100 + MONTH(), si.item_type

SELECT st.store_id, COALESCE(si.seller_sku, '') AS seller_sku, '' AS country, YEAR() * 100 + MONTH() AS period, si.item_type, SUM(si.amount * st.exchange_rate) AS amount FROM ecom_settlement_item si JOIN ecom_settlement st ON st.id = si.settlement_id WHERE si.item_type IN ('ORDER', 'REFUND', 'MARKETPLACE_TAX') AND >= #{begin} AND <= #{end} AND (si.platform_order_no IS NULL OR si.platform_order_no = '' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_order o WHERE o.store_id = st.store_id AND o.platform_order_no = si.platform_order_no)) AND st.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY st.store_id, COALESCE(si.seller_sku, ''), YEAR() * 100 + MONTH(), si.item_type

SELECT o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, COALESCE(o.ship_country, '') AS country, YEAR(f.first_posted) * 100 + MONTH(f.first_posted) AS period, MAX(oi.material_id) AS material_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(x.head) AS order_heads, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.vat_amount, 0) * o.exchange_rate) AS vat, SUM(COALESCE(oi.cost, 0)) AS cost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' THEN x.share * COALESCE(o.shipping_cost, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS head_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' THEN 0 ELSE x.share * COALESCE(o.shipping_cost, 0) END) AS last_mile FROM (SELECT st.store_id, si.platform_order_no, MIN() AS first_posted FROM ecom_settlement_item si JOIN ecom_settlement st ON st.id = si.settlement_id WHERE si.item_type = 'ORDER' AND si.platform_order_no IS NOT NULL AND si.platform_order_no <> '' AND st.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY st.store_id, si.platform_order_no) f JOIN ecom_order o ON o.store_id = f.store_id AND o.platform_order_no = f.platform_order_no JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN ( JOIN ( GROUP BY oi3.order_id) t ON t.order_id = oi2.order_id) x ON x.item_id = oi.id WHERE f.first_posted >= #{begin} AND f.first_posted <= #{end} GROUP BY o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, COALESCE(o.ship_country, ''), YEAR(f.first_posted) * 100 + MONTH(f.first_posted)

SELECT a.store_id, COALESCE(a.seller_sku, '') AS seller_sku, '' AS country, YEAR(a.ad_date) * 100 + MONTH(a.ad_date) AS period, s.currency, SUM(a.spend) AS amount FROM ecom_ad_daily a JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = a.store_id WHERE a.ad_date >= #{begin} AND a.ad_date <= #{end} AND a.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY a.store_id, COALESCE(a.seller_sku, ''), s.currency, YEAR(a.ad_date) * 100 + MONTH(a.ad_date)
SELECT s.id AS store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.platform, s.marketplace, s.currency, s.owner_id, u.nickname AS owner_name FROM ecom_store s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.owner_id

SELECT l.store_id, l.seller_sku, l.parent_item_id, l.title, l.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name FROM ecom_listing l LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id
l.store_id = #{storeId}
SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name FROM wms_material m WHERE m.id IN #{id}

SELECT COALESCE(o.ship_country, '') AS country, YEAR(o.order_time) * 100 + MONTH(o.order_time) AS period, o.tax_type, o.tax_facilitator AS facilitator, o.currency, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.total_amount - o.refund_amount - o.vat_amount - o.withheld_tax) AS taxable_fc, SUM((o.total_amount - o.refund_amount - o.vat_amount - o.withheld_tax) * o.exchange_rate) AS taxable_base, SUM(o.vat_amount) AS vat_fc, SUM(o.vat_amount * o.exchange_rate) AS vat_base, SUM(o.withheld_tax) AS withheld_fc, SUM(o.withheld_tax * o.exchange_rate) AS withheld_base FROM ecom_order o WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.tax_type IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY COALESCE(o.ship_country, ''), YEAR(o.order_time) * 100 + MONTH(o.order_time), o.tax_type, o.tax_facilitator, o.currency ORDER BY country, period, o.currency

SELECT s.marketplace AS country, YEAR(i.ship_date) * 100 + MONTH(i.ship_date) AS period, SUM(i.duty) AS duty, SUM(i.import_vat) AS import_vat FROM ecom_inbound i JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = i.store_id WHERE i.status IN ('SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED') AND i.ship_date >= #{begin} AND i.ship_date <= #{end} AND i.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY s.marketplace, YEAR(i.ship_date) * 100 + MONTH(i.ship_date) HAVING SUM(i.duty) <> 0 OR SUM(i.import_vat) <> 0
